body: Coordinator lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-16 05:34Z). A worktree created fresh with `git worktree add` has NO ui/node_modules. The full gate (scripts/test-launcher.mjs) then fails before any stage with "ENOENT ... ui\node_modules\typescript\bin\tsc" (the P0's first gate, test-e2df5c8f, in .tmp/wt-f5a3-9474). Before any full gate, or any vitest/tsc run, in a NEW worktree: run `npm ci` in its ui folder. It uses the lockfile, writes only node_modules plus npm's cache, and changes no tracked file. Then re-verify the freeze. Put this in every LAUNCH NOW checklist for a fresh root.
